name: Cabanillas del Campo (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of crimson, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Cabanillas del Campo (a tower and a cross of Calatrava on green above waves).
history: The arms of Cabanillas del Campo were approved on 24 January 1992 and the flag on 22 April 1992; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, divided vertically into three equal parts, crimson at the hoist, white in the centre bearing the municipal arms, and green at the fly.

features.role: Cabanillas del Campo arms — tower and cross of Calatrava on green above waves
